# Paola Bramlett — Senior Product Designer

> Paola Bramlett ("Pao") is a Senior Product Designer based in Oaxaca, Mexico, working remotely with founders and product teams in the US, Canada and Europe. She designs 0→1 products and MVPs, AI product experiences, UX/UI redesigns and design systems, and can also build front-end with AI-assisted development (Claude Code). She works in English and Spanish.

## Who she works with
- Founders building a first product or MVP
- Domain experts (therapists, operations leaders) turning their expertise into software
- Product teams whose product has become hard to use
- Best fit: complex problems where clarity matters — AI-powered products, mental health and wellbeing, kids and families, logistics and fleet operations

## Services
- Product design for new products (0→1): discovery, user flows, information architecture, MVP scope, UX/UI
- AI product UX: making AI predictions and recommendations understandable, trustworthy and actionable
- UX/UI redesigns: simplifying crowded or confusing products
- Design systems: token-based component libraries in Figma
- Prototypes and front-end: clickable prototypes, or working front-end built with AI-assisted development ("vibe coding")
- Product websites and landing pages
- Ongoing design partnership (monthly engagement)

## Pricing and timelines
- Projects are usually quoted at a fixed price after a free intro call; price depends on scope and whether front-end is included.
- A landing page or simple prototype: 3–7 days. Full UX/UI design for an app: typically 2–6 weeks.

## Case studies
- [Genogram tool for therapists](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/genogram-tool-for-therapists/): modern canvas that makes a patient's family system readable at a glance; live and used by mental health professionals. Role: UX/UI Designer.
- [Emotional learning app for kids and parents](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/kids-emotional-learning-app/): games, journaling and check-ins for kids; AI-powered parent view with recommendations. Built with a child therapist. In development, funding on the way. Role: UX/UI Designer.
- [AI fleet maintenance platform](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/ai-fleet-maintenance-platform/): fleet health app where minimal-step manual logs plus connected-tool data let AI predict truck failures and recommend fixes. In development. Role: Senior Product Designer.
- [ExploreTogether](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/exploretogether/): community travel platform built on trust signals (earlier work).
- [EventFlow](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/eventflow/): event planning and RSVP platform (earlier work).
- [MindSpace](https://www.paolabramlett.com/work/mindspace/): mental health support concept built around a guided emotional check-in (concept).

## How she works
1. Discover — align on problem, users and business goal
2. Define — flows, information architecture, MVP scope
3. Design — high-fidelity UI as a system, validated with a prototype
4. Deliver — dev-ready handoff or working front-end

## Tools
Figma, Claude Code, Adobe Illustrator, HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
